findings.title: Dictionary comprehension obscures the loop's intent
findings.body: The new one-liner replaces an explicit loop that builds a dictionary step-by-step. The comprehension hides the per-item transformation (`name.lower()` and `value.strip()`) and makes it harder to add logging or validation later. The original loop is more readable for this simple transformation.

summary.problem: The refactor to a dictionary comprehension reduces readability without a clear benefit.
summary.done_well: The change is minimal and maintains the same behavior. The file’s structure and naming remain consistent.
